Cyclone Barun makes landfall near Cox's Bazar

Cyclone Barun made landfall near Cox's Bazar on Tuesday morning with sustained winds of 120 km/h, Bangladesh's weather office said. Storm surges flooded low-lying villages along the coast within hours.

Officials said 12 people had died so far, most of them when houses collapsed. Rescue teams were still trying to reach several islands, and the toll could change as communications are restored.

The government has opened more than 5,000 shelters and has asked fishing boats to stay in port until the storm weakens over the next day.
